qualitative.response:

We know that multiplying by a number ending in zero simply adds zeros at the end of the other factor's result when multiplied together (for example, $20 \times 3 = 60$). Breaking it up this way gives us:
$15 \times 37 = 15 \times (30+7)$
= $(15 \times 30) + (15 \times 7)$
= $450 + 105$
= $555$
